houses.name: Rhino's River Guard
houses.line: Hold the West Ford, watch the kite and orchid movements. Patience is strength.

houses.name: Kite River General
houses.line: We secure the middle ford and prepare for careful engagement.

houses.name: Orchid River General
houses.line: Patience, observe the currents. Our strength lies in the valley's hidden paths.

houses.name: Tiger's Valley Watch
houses.line: Patience, brothers. We observe the currents before striking.
